issues.t: Harsh, abrupt or delayed shifting
issues.sym: Hard or jerky shifts, the transmission holding too high a gear so the engine lugs and vibrates, getting stuck in first, or a transmission warning with limp mode.
issues.why: Shift-control software on both the early six-speed and the later nine-speed automatics causes rough shifting. Land Rover has issued several software updates and service bulletins for it.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check for the latest transmission software and related bulletins. If the warning light comes on, have codes read before driving far.

issues.t: Engine stalls at stops or shuts off while driving
issues.sym: The engine dies at a light or stop sign, sometimes in hot weather or after an auto stop-start, with gear, battery or gearbox warnings. Screens and climate controls may shut off too.
issues.why: Owners report stalling linked to stop-start, low 12-volt battery voltage and software faults. Dealers often cannot reproduce it, and some cases were fixed with battery replacement and software updates.
issues.next: Note when it happens and any messages shown, then report it to a dealer and to NHTSA. Ask about software updates and have the battery tested. Turning off auto stop-start may help in the meantime.

issues.t: Battery runs down early and won't start
issues.sym: Slow cranking, a dead battery, a no-start after sitting, or a string of battery and electrical warnings.
issues.why: Owners report batteries with weak cells replaced early, and the electronics draw power even when parked.
issues.next: Have the battery and charging system tested. A new battery usually needs to be registered to the car with a scan tool.

issues.t: Low battery warning or no-start after sitting
issues.sym: A 'battery low' warning at start-up, a flat battery after parking a few days, or the SUV not starting.
issues.why: Land Rover issued several bulletins for 12-volt battery drain and charging warnings on these model years.
issues.next: Have a dealer check for the battery-related bulletins and software. A battery maintainer helps if the SUV sits for long periods.

issues.t: Engine shuts down in heavy rain
issues.sym: The engine loses power or shuts off at highway speed in heavy rain or very humid weather, sometimes going into limp mode.
issues.why: Water can be drawn into the turbo intake. Dealers fitted a mesh screen and updated software, but some owners had repeat problems.
issues.next: Ask a dealer whether your car has the intake screen and software update. Slow down in heavy rain and avoid deep standing water.

issues.t: Misfire from a failed fuel injector
issues.sym: Shaking under acceleration, a check engine light, and a 'restricted performance' message.
issues.why: Owners report single fuel injectors and spark plugs failing, causing a misfire on one cylinder.
issues.next: Have misfire codes read and the injector tested. Replacing one injector is a moderate repair.

issues.t: Camshaft sensor or timing fault causes limp mode
issues.sym: Check engine light, reduced power, or limp mode.
issues.why: Owners report failed camshaft sensors and, in one case, a broken pin on the camshaft timing gear.
issues.next: Have the codes read right away. A timing fault can damage the engine if ignored.

issues.t: Fuel pump or fuel pump module failure
issues.sym: The engine stalls or won't start, or it loses power while driving.
issues.why: Owners report fuel pump failures, and one case where the fuel pump control received too much voltage and cut fuel; a service bulletin covered it.
issues.next: Have fuel pressure and the fuel pump module tested, and ask the dealer about related bulletins.

issues.t: Check engine light from evap leak-check pump
issues.sym: Check engine light with an evaporative emissions code; the car drives normally.
issues.why: The evap system leak-detection (DMTL) pump can fail.
issues.next: Check the gas cap first, then have the evap codes diagnosed. It is not urgent but will fail an emissions test.

issues.t: Rotary gear selector fails or won't leave Park
issues.sym: The rotary shifter won't rise or turn, the SUV can't be shifted out of Park, or it rolls when you thought it was in Park.
issues.why: The motorized rotary gear selector can fail.
issues.next: Always use the parking brake. Have the selector and its codes checked; replacement is usually needed.

issues.t: Electronic parking brake failure
issues.sym: Parking brake warning, or the parking brake won't apply or release on one side.
issues.why: The electric motor on the rear brake caliper can fail.
issues.next: Have the parking brake system scanned. Use wheel chocks when parking until it is repaired.

issues.t: Headlight bulbs burn out often
issues.sym: One or both headlights go out, sometimes again soon after a new bulb.
issues.why: Owners report frequent bulb failures, including one traced to excess voltage on the driver side.
issues.next: Replace bulbs in pairs. If one side keeps failing, have the headlight circuit voltage checked.

issues.t: Doors won't lock or unlock, or key not detected
issues.sym: Doors that won't unlock, a door lock that stops working, or a 'key not found' message.
issues.why: Owners report door lock actuator failures and keyless-entry faults, some fixed with software updates.
issues.next: Try the spare key and replace the fob battery. If the problem continues, ask a dealer about software updates or a lock actuator.

issues.t: Water leaks into the cabin
issues.sym: Wet carpets in the rear seat area, damp smell, or water in the rear quarter panels of the convertible.
issues.why: Water gets in through body seals. One owner needed six repair visits; another found water in the convertible's rear quarters.
issues.next: Find the leak quickly and dry the interior; water can damage wiring and modules.

issues.t: Windshield or wiper cowl leak soaks electronics
issues.sym: Water inside near the dash, a black touchscreen, warning lights, or electrical faults after rain.
issues.why: Owners report windshield and wiper-box leaks letting water reach electrical parts. Some claims were denied under warranty.
issues.next: Have the windshield seal and cowl drains checked as soon as you see water, and keep repair records.

issues.t: Coolant level low warning or coolant leak
issues.sym: A 'coolant level low' message, coolant drips, or a sweet smell.
issues.why: Land Rover issued several bulletins for low coolant warnings and coolant leaks on these years.
issues.next: Check the level when cold and top up with the correct coolant. Ask a dealer to check for the related bulletins.

issues.t: Rough running or misfire with check engine light
issues.sym: Shaking at idle, rough running, reduced power, and a check engine light.
issues.why: Land Rover issued bulletins for misfires and rough running, some tied to ignition and spark plug wiring.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask the dealer to check for the related bulletins.

issues.t: 48-volt mild-hybrid battery goes offline
issues.sym: Warnings about the hybrid system, stop-start not working, or charging warnings.
issues.why: Land Rover issued a bulletin for the 48-volt mild-hybrid battery losing communication.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check for the bulletin and software update.

issues.t: Touchscreen goes black or loses GPS, USB and apps
issues.sym: Blank or frozen screen, lost GPS location and clock, USB ports not working, or connected apps disappearing.
issues.why: The infotainment system has many software bulletins for these problems.
issues.next: Restart the system, then ask a dealer for the latest software. Over-the-air updates sometimes fail and need a dealer visit.

issues.t: DC-DC converter overload can cut drive power (recall)
issues.sym: Charging warnings, then possible loss of drive power or exterior lights while driving.
issues.why: On mild-hybrid models the DC-DC converter can overload, or software can stop it working at start-up.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm both related recalls (26V248 and 26V599) are done. The fix is free.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may be switched off (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag may be disabled even with an adult in the seat.
issues.why: A part in the occupant classification system can fail.
issues.next: Have a dealer install the free software update.

issues.t: Transmission can shift into neutral (recall)
issues.sym: The transmission suddenly shifts to neutral and the SUV loses drive.
issues.why: Weak wire crimps at a transmission sensor can lose contact.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the transmission and update the software, free.

issues.t: Front lower control arm bolts can fail (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the front, or in the worst case the front wheel can separate from the suspension.
issues.why: An assembly error can cause the control arm fasteners to fail.
issues.next: Contact a dealer; the fasteners are replaced free.

issues.t: Fuel rail end caps can leak (recall)
issues.sym: Fuel smell in or around the engine bay.
issues.why: End caps on the fuel rail of the 2.0L engine may leak, which is a fire risk.
issues.next: Stop driving if you smell fuel and contact a dealer. The fuel rail is replaced free.

issues.t: Airbag warning light comes on falsely (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag (SRS) warning light comes and goes.
issues.why: Wrongly programmed software can switch the warning light on, which could hide a real fault.
issues.next: Have a dealer update the restraint module software, free.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may tear when it deploys (recall)
issues.sym: No warning before a crash.
issues.why: The front passenger airbag can tear during deployment and may let hot gas escape.
issues.next: Contact a dealer; the airbag module is repaired free.

issues.t: Touchscreen can stay blank and hide rear camera (recall)
issues.sym: The center screen stays blank after starting, so there is no backup camera image.
issues.why: A touchscreen software fault.
issues.next: Have a dealer install the free software update.

issues.t: Water can get into rear camera (recall)
issues.sym: No image or a distorted image from the rearview camera.
issues.why: Water can leak into the camera housing.
issues.next: A dealer will replace the camera free.

issues.t: Front sensing camera module can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: Camera views can go blank and driver-assist features may stop working.
issues.why: The near-field sensing module can overheat.
issues.next: Contact a dealer; the module is replaced free.
